title: Indonesia | World Coffee Guide
description: Indonesian arabica is known for a heavy body, low acidity and earthy, cedary flavours, which come mostly from the way much of it is processed. Most of the country's coffee is actually robusta from southern Sumatra, and the arabica you see on specialty menus comes from smaller areas such as Gayo, Lintong, Toraja, Kintamani and Flores, with a little from Java and Papua.
seoDescription: Indonesia coffee guide: wet-hulled arabica, Gayo and Lintong, and the robusta belt in southern Sumatra.
